mapper.select: SELECT hero_id AS heroId, name, title, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, base_stats::text AS baseStatsJson, stats_by_level::text AS statsByLevelJson FROM public.heroes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} ORDER BY hero_id

SELECT hero_id AS heroId, name, title, avatar_url AS avatarUrl, base_stats::text AS baseStatsJson, stats_by_level::text AS statsByLevelJson FROM public.heroes WHERE game_id = #{gameId} AND hero_id = #{heroId}
mapper.update: INSERT INTO public.heroes (game_id, hero_id, start_version_id, end_version_id, name, title, avatar_url, base_stats, stats_by_level, updated_at) VALUES (#{gameId}, #{heroId}, #{versionId}, #{versionId}, #{name}, #{title}, #{avatarUrl}, CAST(#{baseStatsJson} AS jsonb), CAST(#{statsByLevelJson} AS jsonb), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (game_id, hero_id) DO UPDATE SET start_version_id = EXCLUDED.start_version_id, end_version_id = EXCLUDED.end_version_id, name = EXCLUDED.name, title = EXCLUDED.title, avatar_url = EXCLUDED.avatar_url, base_stats = EXCLUDED.base_stats, stats_by_level = EXCLUDED.stats_by_level, updated_at = NOW()
